name: NorthRay Capture
tagline: Livestreaming and recording for Windows, in the NorthRay look. In development: it captures your screen, windows, cameras and sound, but doesn't record or stream yet.
description: NorthRay Capture is a livestreaming and recording app for Windows, being built in stages towards a real alternative to OBS Studio: per-application audio (stream a game and your microphone while music and voice chat stay private), streaming to several platforms at once from one encode, and staying light on older PCs. This version captures a whole display, a single window or a camera or capture card into a live preview, where you arrange them in scenes, and captures sound: microphones and other inputs, desktop audio (everything you hear), and on Windows 11 one program's sound on its own. Each sound source has a meter, a volume fader and mute, and can save a 10-second test clip of just its own sound. It doesn't record or stream yet, and separate stream, recording and headphone mixes come next.
features: Capture a whole display (Desktop Duplication, with Windows Graphics Capture and a compatibility mode as fallbacks), with or without the mouse pointer
Capture one window, even when it's covered (Windows Graphics Capture); it's found again when the program restarts
Webcams and capture cards that Windows sees as cameras

Sound: microphones and other inputs, desktop audio (everything an output device plays), and on Windows 11 one program's sound on its own (a game without your music or voice chat), each found again when the device or program comes back
An audio mixer with level meters, a volume fader and mute for each sound source, and the mix
Save a 10-second test clip of any sound source's own sound, to hear exactly what it captures
A live preview: drag to move, drag the handles to resize (Shift for any shape), Alt+drag to crop, with snapping to the canvas edges and centre (hold Ctrl to stop it)
Fit, stretch, centre, rotate, mirror, reset; hide, lock and reorder sources; the arrow keys nudge
Scenes: add, rename, duplicate, reorder and delete, switch with Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+9; a source can be shared by several scenes and is captured once
The workspace: resize, rearrange, hide and save the panels as layouts
Light on the computer: when the preview is hidden and nothing is recording or streaming, nothing is composed
Settings: theme, low-resource mode, preview and output frame rates, canvas size (1080p, 720p, 1440p or vertical 9:16); the encoders your PC offers
Not yet: separate stream, recording and headphone mixes, recording and streaming (each arrives in a later version)
